## What he does

Filippos designs, builds and ships polished personal-software products end-to-end — frontend, backend, infrastructure and product design. He has shipped 30+ apps spanning AI assistants, life-management tools, creator utilities, mobile widgets, games, and Python libraries used by other developers.

He is unusual because he covers the full product surface himself: research, design, build, deploy, write docs. He is comfortable working solo or embedded in a small team.

## Headline projects

- **LifeHub** — local-first personal dashboard that catches every loose end (tasks, notes, photos, voice memos, links, habits, calendar, emails) and makes them searchable. Next.js + IndexedDB + optional Supabase sync + OpenAI. https://github.com/philipposk/LifeHub
- **Cosmo** — creative-AI home for stories, art, libraries, forums and goals; privacy on by default. Next.js + NestJS + Prisma + BullMQ + Stripe.
- **Daisy** — privacy-minded Mac voice assistant; wake-word listening, TTS responses, MCP-driven desktop automation. Released through v0.5. https://github.com/philipposk/Daisy--AI-Assistant-
- **AI OS** — semi-autonomous multi-agent coding orchestrator using LangGraph; rotates across free LLM providers (Groq, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM, Ollama) with human-in-the-loop checkpoints and Slack/Telegram bots.
- **Praiser** — multilingual hype chatbot for the people you love. Next.js. https://github.com/philipposk/Praiser

## Libraries other developers use

- **llm-free-rotator** (PyPI) — rotate across free-tier LLM models when one rate-limits you.
- **telegram-mcp** — Telegram MCP server for Claude integration. https://github.com/philipposk/telegram-mcp
- **Page Assistant** — a talking, grounded assistant you drop into any web app; reads the page, runs real actions, publishes an llm.txt so other agents can use the app too. https://github.com/philipposk/page-assistant
- **agent-feedback** — tiny universal protocol letting LLMs and agents send improvement tickets back to the apps they use. https://github.com/philipposk/agent-feedback
- **harness-forge** — already listed above.
